import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import xgboost as xgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371  # Earth's radius in kilometers
    lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(np.radians, [lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2])
    dlat = lat2 - lat1
    dlon = lon2 - lon1
    a = np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    c = 2 * np.arcsin(np.sqrt(a))
    return R * c


def manhattan_distance(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    return abs(lat2 - lat1) + abs(lon2 - lon1)


def bearing(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2 = map(np.radians, [lon1, lat1, lon2, lon2])
    dlon = lon2 - lon1
    x = np.sin(dlon) * np.cos(lat2)
    y = np.cos(lat1) * np.sin(lat2) - np.sin(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.cos(dlon)
    bearing = np.arctan2(x, y)
    return np.degrees(bearing)


def add_nyc_zones(df):
    manhattan_lat_min, manhattan_lat_max = 40.70, 40.86
    manhattan_lon_min, manhattan_lon_max = -74.02, -73.93
    jfk_lat_min, jfk_lat_max = 40.63, 40.66
    jfk_lon_min, jfk_lon_max = -73.82, -73.77
    lga_lat_min, lga_lat_max = 40.77, 40.78
    lga_lon_min, lga_lon_max = -73.88, -73.86
    ewc_lat_min, ewc_lat_max = 40.68, 40.71
    ewc_lon_min, ewc_lon_max = -74.20, -74.16

    df["pickup_in_manhattan"] = (
        (df["pickup_latitude"].between(manhattan_lat_min, manhattan_lat_max))
        & (df["pickup_longitude"].between(manhattan_lon_min, manhattan_lon_max))
    ).astype(int)

    df["pickup_near_jfk"] = (
        (df["pickup_latitude"].between(jfk_lat_min, jfk_lat_max))
        & (df["pickup_longitude"].between(jfk_lon_min, jfk_lon_max))
    ).astype(int)

    df["pickup_near_lga"] = (
        (df["pickup_latitude"].between(lga_lat_min, lga_lat_max))
        & (df["pickup_longitude"].between(lga_lon_min, lga_lon_max))
    ).astype(int)

    df["pickup_near_newark"] = (
        (df["pickup_latitude"].between(ewc_lat_min, ewc_lat_max))
        & (df["pickup_longitude"].between(ewc_lon_min, ewc_lon_max))
    ).astype(int)

    df["dropoff_in_manhattan"] = (
        (df["dropoff_latitude"].between(manhattan_lat_min, manhattan_lat_max))
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"].between(manhattan_lon_min, manhattan_lon_max))
    ).astype(int)

    df["dropoff_near_jfk"] = (
        (df["dropoff_latitude"].between(jfk_lat_min, jfk_lat_max))
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"].between(jfk_lon_min, jfk_lon_max))
    ).astype(int)

    df["dropoff_near_lga"] = (
        (df["dropoff_latitude"].between(lga_lat_min, lga_lat_max))
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"].between(lga_lon_min, lga_lon_max))
    ).astype(int)

    df["dropoff_near_newark"] = (
        (df["dropoff_latitude"].between(ewc_lat_min, ewc_lat_max))
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"].between(ewc_lon_min, ewc_lon_max))
    ).astype(int)

    df["pickup_to_manhattan"] = (
        (df["pickup_latitude"].between(manhattan_lat_min, manhattan_lat_max))
        & ~(
            (df["dropoff_latitude"].between(manhattan_lat_min, manhattan_lat_max))
            & (df["dropoff_longitude"].between(manhattan_lon_min, manhattan_lon_max))
        )
    ).astype(int)

    df["manhattan_to_airport"] = (
        (
            (df["pickup_latitude"].between(manhattan_lat_min, manhattan_lat_max))
            & (df["pickup_longitude"].between(manhattan_lon_min, manhattan_lon_max))
        )
        & (
            (
                df["dropoff_near_jfk"]
                | df["dropoff_near_lga"]
                | df["dropoff_near_newark"]
            )
            == 1
        )
    ).astype(int)

    df["airport_to_manhattan"] = (
        (
            (df["dropoff_latitude"].between(manhattan_lat_min, manhattan_lat_max))
            & (df["dropoff_longitude"].between(manhattan_lon_min, manhattan_lon_max))
        )
        & (
            (df["pickup_near_jfk"] | df["pickup_near_lga"] | df["pickup_near_newark"])
            == 1
        )
    ).astype(int)


def add_landmark_distances(df):
    central_park = (40.7829, -73.9654)
    jfk = (40.6413, -73.7781)
    lga = (40.7769, -73.8740)
    ewc = (40.6895, -74.1745)
    port_auth = (40.7575, -73.9855)

    df["pickup_to_central_park"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"].values,
        df["pickup_longitude"].values,
        central_park[0],
        central_park[1],
    )
    df["dropoff_to_central_park"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"].values,
        df["dropoff_longitude"].values,
        central_park[0],
        central_park[1],
    )
    df["pickup_to_jfk"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"].values, df["pickup_longitude"].values, jfk[0], jfk[1]
    )
    df["dropoff_to_jfk"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"].values, df["dropoff_longitude"].values, jfk[0], jfk[1]
    )
    df["pickup_to_lga"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"].values, df["pickup_longitude"].values, lga[0], lga[1]
    )
    df["dropoff_to_lga"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"].values, df["dropoff_longitude"].values, lga[0], lga[1]
    )
    df["pickup_to_newark"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"].values, df["pickup_longitude"].values, ewc[0], ewc[1]
    )
    df["dropoff_to_newark"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"].values, df["dropoff_longitude"].values, ewc[0], ewc[1]
    )
    df["pickup_to_port_auth"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"].values,
        df["pickup_longitude"].values,
        port_auth[0],
        port_auth[1],
    )
    df["dropoff_to_port_auth"] = haversine(
        df["dropoff_latitude"].values,
        df["dropoff_longitude"].values,
        port_auth[0],
        port_auth[1],
    )


def compute_expected_travel_time(df):
    """
    Compute expected travel time (minutes) as haversine distance / time-of-day-dependent average speed.
    Speed profiles reflect typical NYC traffic: slower during rush hours and on weekends.
    """
    # Average speeds by hour of day (km/h) — derived from typical NYC traffic patterns
    hour_speed_map = {
        0: 22,
        1: 24,
        2: 26,
        3: 28,
        4: 28,
        5: 26,
        6: 20,
        7: 16,
        8: 15,
        9: 18,
        10: 20,
        11: 19,
        12: 18,
        13: 19,
        14: 20,
        15: 20,
        16: 18,
        17: 15,
        18: 14,
        19: 17,
        20: 20,
        21: 22,
        22: 23,
        23: 24,
    }

    hour_speed = df["hour"].map(hour_speed_map).values.astype(np.float32)

    # Adjust for day of week (weekends slower due to unpredictable traffic)
    speed_modifier = np.where(df["dayofweek"] >= 5, 0.85, 1.0)

    # Compute travel time in minutes
    travel_time = (df["haversine_dist"].values / hour_speed) * 60 * speed_modifier

    # Clamp extreme values
    travel_time = np.clip(travel_time, 2.0, 120.0)

    return travel_time


train = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

mask = (
    (train["pickup_latitude"].between(40, 42))
    & (train["pickup_longitude"].between(-75, -73))
    & (train["dropoff_latitude"].between(40, 42))
    & (train["dropoff_longitude"].between(-75, -73))
    & (train["fare_amount"] > 0)
    & (train["passenger_count"] > 0)
    & (train["passenger_count"] <= 6)
)

valid_idx = train[mask].index

train.loc[valid_idx, "haversine_dist"] = haversine(
    train.loc[valid_idx, "pickup_latitude"].values,
    train.loc[valid_idx, "pickup_longitude"].values,
    train.loc[valid_idx, "dropoff_latitude"].values,
    train.loc[valid_idx, "dropoff_longitude"].values,
)

train.loc[valid_idx, "manhattan_dist"] = manhattan_distance(
    train.loc[valid_idx, "pickup_latitude"].values,
    train.loc[valid_idx, "pickup_longitude"].values,
    train.loc[valid_idx, "dropoff_latitude"].values,
    train.loc[valid_idx, "dropoff_longitude"].values,
)

train.loc[valid_idx, "bearing"] = bearing(
    train.loc[valid_idx, "pickup_latitude"].values,
    train.loc[valid_idx, "pickup_longitude"].values,
    train.loc[valid_idx, "dropoff_latitude"].values,
    train.loc[valid_idx, "dropoff_longitude"].values,
)

train = train[
    mask & (train["haversine_dist"] > 0.1) & (train["haversine_dist"] < 100)
].copy()

train["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(train["pickup_datetime"])
train["hour"] = train["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
train["dayofweek"] = train["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
train["month"] = train["pickup_datetime"].dt.month

train["delta_lat"] = train["dropoff_latitude"] - train["pickup_latitude"]
train["delta_lon"] = train["dropoff_longitude"] - train["pickup_longitude"]
train["bearing_rad"] = np.radians(train["bearing"])
train["bearing_sin"] = np.sin(train["bearing_rad"])
train["bearing_cos"] = np.cos(train["bearing_rad"])

add_nyc_zones(train)
add_landmark_distances(train)
train["travel_time"] = compute_expected_travel_time(train)

# Feature cols with new travel_time
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "hour",
    "dayofweek",
    "month",
    "haversine_dist",
    "manhattan_dist",
    "delta_lat",
    "delta_lon",
    "bearing_sin",
    "bearing_cos",
    "pickup_in_manhattan",
    "pickup_near_jfk",
    "pickup_near_lga",
    "pickup_near_newark",
    "dropoff_in_manhattan",
    "dropoff_near_jfk",
    "dropoff_near_lga",
    "dropoff_near_newark",
    "pickup_to_manhattan",
    "manhattan_to_airport",
    "airport_to_manhattan",
    "pickup_to_central_park",
    "dropoff_to_central_park",
    "pickup_to_jfk",
    "dropoff_to_jfk",
    "pickup_to_lga",
    "dropoff_to_lga",
    "pickup_to_newark",
    "dropoff_to_newark",
    "pickup_to_port_auth",
    "dropoff_to_port_auth",
    "travel_time",
]

train_sample = train.sample(n=min(5000000, len(train)), random_state=42)
X_train, X_val = train_test_split(train_sample, test_size=0.1, random_state=42)

xgb_train = xgb.DMatrix(X_train[feature_cols], label=X_train["fare_amount"])
xgb_val = xgb.DMatrix(X_val[feature_cols], label=X_val["fare_amount"])

params = {
    "objective": "reg:squarederror",
    "eval_metric": "rmse",
    "max_depth": 12,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.9,
    "gamma": 0.1,
    "reg_alpha": 1,
    "reg_lambda": 1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

model = xgb.train(
    params,
    xgb_train,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    evals=[(xgb_val, "val")],
    early_stopping_rounds=50,
    verbose_eval=False,
)

val_preds = model.predict(xgb_val)
val_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(X_val["fare_amount"], val_preds))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

test["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(test["pickup_datetime"])
test["hour"] = test["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
test["dayofweek"] = test["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
test["month"] = test["pickup_datetime"].dt.month

test["haversine_dist"] = haversine(
    test["pickup_latitude"].values,
    test["pickup_longitude"].values,
    test["dropoff_latitude"].values,
    test["dropoff_longitude"].values,
)

test["manhattan_dist"] = manhattan_distance(
    test["pickup_latitude"].values,
    test["pickup_longitude"].values,
    test["dropoff_latitude"].values,
    test["dropoff_longitude"].values,
)

test["bearing"] = bearing(
    test["pickup_latitude"].values,
    test["pickup_longitude"].values,
    test["dropoff_latitude"].values,
    test["dropoff_longitude"].values,
)

test["delta_lat"] = test["dropoff_latitude"] - test["pickup_latitude"]
test["delta_lon"] = test["dropoff_longitude"] - test["pickup_longitude"]
test["bearing_rad"] = np.radians(test["bearing"])
test["bearing_sin"] = np.sin(test["bearing_rad"])
test["bearing_cos"] = np.cos(test["bearing_rad"])

add_nyc_zones(test)
add_landmark_distances(test)
test["travel_time"] = compute_expected_travel_time(test)

test_preds = model.predict(xgb.DMatrix(test[feature_cols]))

submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
submission["fare_amount"] = test_preds
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
